sources.title: Introducing Whisper - OpenAI
sources.snippet: We've trained and are open-sourcing a neural net called Whisper that approaches human level robustness and accuracy on English speech recognition.

sources.title: Agentic-Voice-Sandbox/README.md at main · shlokdhanokar ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: A local, voice-controlled AI agent that turns spoken commands into executed tasks. It transcribes audio via Whisper, classifies intents using LLMs, and safely executes sandboxed code generation or file operations. Features dual-audio processing, human-in-the-loop safety, and a premium Streamlit UI.

sources.title: I Built a Voice-Controlled Local AI Agent - Medium
sources.snippet: I Build a local AI agent that accepts voice commands, understands intent, and executes actions on your machine. No cloud LLM, no OpenAI…
